tier_definitions.T1_CANONICAL: First-party terms, reward rules, product rules, merchant rules, or official technical documentation.
tier_definitions.T2_OFFICIAL_SUPPORT: First-party FAQ, campaign directory, merchant directory, support page, or official explainer.
tier_definitions.T3_PARTNER_CONTRACT: Licensed API, contractual feed, or partner-delivered data. Add only after contract review.
tier_definitions.T4_DISCOVERY_ONLY: Third-party comparison or community signal; never sufficient for production publication.
